title: Ɔkra a Ɔsom Bo a Obisaa Tumi Ho Asɛm
intro: Wɔ Kur’aan abakɔsɛm mu no, na onipa bi te ase a n’ahonyade ne ne nimdeɛ bɛyɛɛ anansesɛm. Saa ɔkra yi de agude ne ahonyade a ɛmaa wɔn a wɔhwɛe no ani gyei fii asase so bae, nanso wɔn koma de ahantan yɛɛ ahantan. Kɔka yɛn ho bere a yɛrebue ahintasɛm a ɛwɔ Kuran no mu anansesɛm a ɛyɛ kɔkɔbɔ sen biara no biako mu, faako a honam fam kɛseyɛ hyia awiei a ɛyɛ ahobrɛase wɔ asase ankasa a ɛwoo wɔn ahonyade no ase.
clues: Mifii asase a wɔde agude a ɛkyere obiara ani asiesie so puei.
Ná mewɔ ahonyade akɛse ne nimdeɛ a emu dɔ a ɛma meda nsow wɔ afoforo ho.
Bere a ɔbɔfo bi bae sɛ ɔrefrɛ nkurɔfo aba Allah nkyɛn no, mede ahomaso gyee wɔn tumidi ho kyim.
Nkurafoa a watwa me ho ahyia no kaa sesem se Allah adom nnye m'ahonyadee fibea.
Me nkurɔfo ho dwiriw wɔn wɔ me kɛseyɛ no ho na wɔpɛe sɛ nkrabea a ɛte sɛ me de no bɛba.
Wɔmenee m’adan a ɛyɛ nwonwa no nyinaa guu asase mu sɛ ɔsoro asotwe.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
